# Prime Dental Group

> > Prime Dental Group offers comprehensive family, cosmetic, and pediatric dentistry services in Bellevue and Lynnwood, Washington, led by Drs. Yongjae Kim and Hye-Jin Kim.

Prime Dental Group operates two locations in the Seattle metropolitan area, providing a full range of general, cosmetic, and specialized dental services. The practice emphasizes patient care with flexible payment options including a loyalty membership plan for uninsured patients.
